'''Jared Strait''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2000 Utica tournament]] in October 2000 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor OPS]], according to Casey Galvan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1363">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-19-wotc-utica-mid1363/ wotc-utica-mi], DeckTech (Jason "TrenchRunner" Aubry, 19 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-19-wotc-utica-mid1363/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
